input:
We're trying to synchronize capture from three cameras using the V4L2 Request API. Two of the three cameras capture in sync, but the third consistently misses its frame by 1-2 frame periods. All three sensors are on separate MIPI CSI-2 interfaces with hardware sync triggers.

v4l2-ctl output:
  Camera 0 (IMX577): /dev/video0, streaming at 30fps, request fd=10
  Camera 1 (IMX577): /dev/video2, streaming at 30fps, request fd=11
  Camera 2 (OV13B): /dev/video4, streaming at 30fps, request fd=12

Timestamp analysis (CLOCK_MONOTONIC, nanoseconds):
  Frame N:   cam0=500000000  cam1=500100000  cam2=533400000  (cam2 late by 33.4ms)
  Frame N+1: cam0=533333333  cam1=533433333  cam2=566700000  (cam2 late by 33.4ms)
  Frame N+2: cam0=566666666  cam1=566766666  cam2=600100000  (cam2 late by 33.4ms)

dmesg:
[   30.100] imx577 2-001a: hardware trigger mode enabled
[   30.101] imx577 3-001a: hardware trigger mode enabled
[   30.102] ov13b 4-0036: hardware trigger mode enabled
[   30.103] ov13b 4-0036: WARNING: FSIN delay register = 0x0100 (256 lines)

The OV13B has a different FSIN (frame sync input) delay configuration. Is this the cause?
